title: Anterior Posterior 6X
author: Michael Aslanidis
desc: Unleash your strength with the Anterior Posterior 6X program, a comprehensive 20-week journey designed for intermediate lifters. With six days of targeted training each week, you'll focus on building muscle and enhancing strength through a balanced approach that emphasizes both anterior and posterior muscle groups. Each 60-minute session utilizes a full gym setup, ensuring you have the tools needed to push your limits and achieve impressive gains. Get ready to transform your physique and elevate your performance!
